The University of Bergen invites applications for an Associate Professor position focused on Interaction Design and Intelligent User Interfaces.

The position is in the Department of Information Science and Media Studies and is linked to the Bachelor’s and Master’s programs in Media and Interaction Design (MIX). The position will strengthen the department’s research, teaching, and external collaboration at the intersection of interaction design, intelligent user interfaces, media technology, artificial intelligence, human-centred intelligent systems, and innovation in the media and creative-technology industries.

The application deadline is the 11th of October. For more information about the position, please follow the link (Associate professor in Media and interaction design (307797) | University of Bergen<
>) and don't hesitate to contact us.
